arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week. The database service is currently degraded with all connections in use and no worker throughput. The pg_dump export of the failed_jobs table has been started and is estimated to take 20 minutes. Logs for the database service have been read and the failed_jobs count has been queried.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the cause of the degraded database service and clear the failed_jobs backlog.
